title: Small Molecule Interactions with Biomacromolecules: DNA Binding Interactions of a Manganese(III) Schiff Base Complex with Potential Anticancer Activities.
authors: Khatun, Rousunara; Modak, Ritwik; Islam, Abu Saleh Musha; Moni, Dolan; Sepay, Nayim; Mukherjee, Rimi; Das, Gaurav; Murmu, Nabendu; Ali, Mahammad
one_liner_zh: 该文研究锰(III)席夫碱配合物与ct-DNA的小分子结合，含分子对接但非TF-DNA体系，方法以实验为主、AI/物理模拟深度不足。
abstract: A manganese(III) complex, [Mn(III)(L)(SCN)(enH)](NO(3)).H(2)O (1*H(2)O) (H(2)L = 2-((E)-(2-((E)-2-hydroxy-3-methoxybenzylidene-amino)-ethyl-imino)methyl)-6-methoxyphenol), has been synthesized and characterized by single-crystal X-ray diffraction analysis. The interaction of 1*H(2)O with DNA was studied by monitoring the decrease in absorbance of the complex at lambda = 324 nm with the increase in DNA concentration, providing an opportunity to determine the binding constant of the 1*H(2)O-ct-DNA complex as 5.63 x 10(3) M(-1). Similarly, fluorescence titration was carried out by adding ct-DNA gradually and monitoring the increase in emission intensity at 453 nm on excitation at lambda(ex) = 324 nm. A linear form of the Benesi-Hildebrand equation yields a binding constant of 4.40 x 10(3) M(-1) at 25  degrees C, establishing the self-consistency of our results obtained from absorption and fluorescence titrations. The competitive displacement reactions of dyes like ethidium bromide, Hoechst, and DAPI (4',6-diamidine-2'-phenylindole dihydrochloride) from dye-ct-DNA conjugates by 1*H(2)O were analyzed, and the corresponding K(SV) values are 1.05 x 10(4), 1.25 x 10(4), and 1.35 x 10(4) M(-1) and the K(app) values are 2.16 x 10(3), 8.34 x 10(3), and 9.0 x 10(3) M(-1), from which it is difficult to infer the preference of groove binding over intercalation by these DNA trackers. However, the molecular docking experiments and viscosity measurement clearly indicate the preference for minor groove binding over intercalation, involving a change in Gibbs free energy of -8.56 kcal/mol. The 1*H(2)O complex was then evaluated for its anticancer potential in breast cancer MCF-7 cells, which severely abrogates the growth of the cells in both 2D and 3D mammospheres, indicating its promising application as an anticancer drug through a minor groove binding interaction with ct-DNA.
abstract_zh: 一种锰(III)配合物，[Mn(III)(L)(SCN)(enH)](NO(3)).H(2)O (1*H(2)O)（其中H(2)L = 2-((E)-(2-((E)-2-羟基-3-甲氧基苄叉氨基)-乙基亚氨基)甲基)-6-甲氧基苯酚），已被合成并通过单晶X射线衍射分析进行表征。通过监测1*H(2)O在λ = 324 nm处吸光度随DNA浓度增加而降低，研究了1*H(2)O与DNA的相互作用，从而有机会确定1*H(2)O-ct-DNA复合物的结合常数为5.63 x 10(3) M(-1)。类似地，通过逐步添加ct-DNA并在激发波长λ(ex) = 324 nm下监测453 nm处发射强度的增加，进行了荧光滴定实验。Benesi-Hildebrand方程的线性形式在25摄氏度下得出结合常数为4.40 x 10(3) M(-1)，这证实了我们从吸收和荧光滴定中获得的结果具有自洽性。分析了1*H(2)O对染料如溴化乙锭、Hoechst和DAPI（4',6-二脒基-2'-苯基吲哚二盐酸盐）与ct-DNA结合物进行竞争性置换反应，相应的K(SV)值分别为1.05 x 10(4)、1.25 x 10(4)和1.35 x 10(4) M(-1)，K(app)值分别为2.16 x 10(3)、8.34 x 10(3)和9.0 x 10(3) M(-1)，从中难以推断这些DNA追踪剂对沟槽结合相对于嵌入结合的偏好。然而，分子对接实验和粘度测量明确表明，相对于嵌入结合，更倾向于小沟槽结合，涉及吉布斯自由能变化为-8.56 kcal/mol。随后，评估了1*H(2)O配合物在乳腺癌MCF-7细胞中的抗癌潜力，它严重抑制了细胞在2D和3D乳腺球中的生长，表明其通过与ct-DNA的小沟槽结合相互作用作为抗癌药物的应用前景广阔。
